text: Four years ago, I ran for City Council to ensure every neighborhood in Fullerton is healthy, heard, and heading in the right direction.
As your representative in City Hall, I led successful efforts to repave our streets and restore community events like First Night & 4th of July Fireworks.
I was the driving force behind Fullerton joining the lawsuit against U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement's racial profiling and other illegal practices.
I secured funding for our Fire & Police Departments and helped create the Fiscal Sustainability Committee to ensure Fullerton’s financial sustainability.
I am the only Councilmember who holds weekly office hours because I will always listen to the community.

I am running for re-election to build on this progress. As your Councilmember, I will work to pave 100% of our streets, increase road safety for all, restore our parks and renew our commitment to a sustainably equitable future.

I am honored to have the support of Congressmembers Lou Correa & Derek Tran, California State Senator Tom Umberg, California Assemblymembers Sharon Quirk-Silva & Avelino Valencia, Orange County Supervisors Doug Chaffee & Vicente Sarmiento, Fullerton City Councilmember Ahmad Zahra, and the hard-working families of the National Union of Healthcare Workers, United Food and Commercial Workers & Orange County Employees Association.
I hope to earn your support as well, together we can continue to improve Fullerton’s roads, parks, and finances.

text: My family and I immigrated to the United States when I was 4 years old. We achieved the American Dream: I graduated from UCLA and Harvard, and started a successful career. I married, becoming a father of two children.
This was shattered on August 14, 2015, when a falling tree killed our son in his sleep during our family Yosemite trip.

We turned this tragedy into a way to honor our son, who had planned to start a program providing musical instruments and lessons to underprivileged children: we created the Dragon Kim Foundation to fulfill his dream. We’ve grown to also provide leadership training to help students launch service programs and award college scholarships. 100% of our students go on to college.
Professionally, I’m a turnaround specialist: when companies are failing, I move them back to profitability. As I learned about Fullerton’s multimillion dollar budget deficit, I knew I needed to help.

If you elect me as our Councilmember, I will:
Eliminate waste, make cuts, and increase revenue to fix Fullerton’s budget crisis
Ensure police and firefighters have what they need to protect
Fullerton neighborhoods
Repair Fullerton’s roads after years of neglect
I request your vote to help turn Fullerton around!
